paragraphs.text: Gwendolyn Carthalion (née Gwendolyn Mor) was a blue mage, the daughter of Grenfell Mor , and the wife of Adam Carthalion , as well as Jared Carthalion ’s mother.

Gwendolyn gave birth to Jared Carthalion in the Spring of 4180 AR . A few months later, Adam sacrificed her to the “god” Ravidel in his quest to become a planeswalker . A sculpture of Gwendolyn sat above the Carthalion throne at Castle Melmereth .
